reviews.title: More product options, easy-to-use, excellent quality
reviews.pros: The variety and number of different products offered is great. You can select from t-shirts to caps and much more. The quality of products is excellent with fast shipping times. It integrates easily with bigger platforms like Shopify.
reviews.cons: Sometimes, the shipping gets delayed and not received on expected delivery date. I think some products are overpriced. The prints may get faded with time.
reviews.overall: Printful is very easy to use and design different products like t-shirts. I use it to design merchandise products like t-shirts, caps, hoodies, tote bags, etc for my brand. Any newbie can get used to it in small time.

reviews.title: Too Costly
reviews.pros: They have good software to design products - limited product selection. They good models for mockup but prices don't justify it.
reviews.cons: The setup fees, the high product cost, the super high shipping costs. What profit? I would be paying customers to make a purchase. Changing POD now!
reviews.overall: I am looking to replace Printful. I am losing profits because no one want to buy a $40 embroidered ballcap.

reviews.title: The best print on demand service
reviews.pros: They have great product options and the print quality is the best I've seen in print on demand. Their mockup generator super easy to use and allows you to easily drag and drop images to update products. They've done a great job expanding to international markets, allowing you to sell in international markets at a reasonable rate for international shipping.
reviews.cons: Their prices are a tad high per product as compared to other print on demand platforms, but it's worth paying a premium for the quality of their prints / products and ease of use.
reviews.overall: The best print on demand service you could use. Great products, fantastic print quality, simple ease of use, and easy international distribution. The only downside is they are slightly pricier than other print on demand services, but it is worth it for their ease of use.
